---
title: "Site Map"
format: html
---

```{=html}
<style>
  .sitemap-shell {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1rem;
  }

  .sitemap-summary {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
    gap: 0.8rem;
  }

  .sitemap-stat {
    border: 1px solid #d9d9d9;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
    background: #fafafa;
  }

  .sitemap-stat-label {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #666;
    margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
  }

  .sitemap-stat-value {
    font-size: 1.45rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #111827;
  }

  .sitemap-note {
    margin: 0;
    color: #4b5563;
  }

  .sitemap-groups {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.9rem;
  }

  .sitemap-group {
    border: 1px solid #d9d9d9;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #fff;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .sitemap-group summary {
    list-style: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0.95rem 1rem;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 1rem;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fbfbfb 0%, #f4f4f4 100%);
  }

  .sitemap-group summary::-webkit-details-marker {
    display: none;
  }

  .sitemap-group-title {
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #111827;
  }

  .sitemap-group-count {
    color: #6b7280;
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .sitemap-list {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0;
  }

  .sitemap-item {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
    border-top: 1px solid #ececec;
    align-items: start;
  }

  .sitemap-item:first-child {
    border-top: 0;
  }

  .sitemap-link {
    color: #8b0000;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  .sitemap-link:hover,
  .sitemap-link:focus {
    text-decoration: underline;
  }

  .sitemap-path {
    margin-top: 0.15rem;
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    color: #6b7280;
    word-break: break-word;
  }

  .sitemap-badges {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: flex-end;
  }

  .sitemap-badge {
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: #f3f4f6;
    color: #374151;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  @media (max-width: 700px) {
    .sitemap-item {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .sitemap-badges {
      justify-content: flex-start;
    }
  }
</style>

<div class="sitemap-shell">
  <div id="sitemap-meta" class="sitemap-summary"></div>
  <p class="sitemap-note">This page lists the published pages on the site grouped by section, with basic internal link counts.</p>
  <div id="sitemap-groups" class="sitemap-groups"></div>
</div>

<script>
(async function () {
  const meta = document.getElementById("sitemap-meta");
  const groupsContainer = document.getElementById("sitemap-groups");

  function escapeHtml(str) {
    return String(str)
      .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
      .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
      .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
      .replace(/\"/g, "&quot;")
      .replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
  }

  async function loadSitemapData() {
    // Try multiple path variants so this page works for root, subpath, and local preview URLs.
    const candidates = [
      "files/site/sitemap-data.json",
      "./files/site/sitemap-data.json",
      "/files/site/sitemap-data.json",
      "../files/site/sitemap-data.json"
    ];

    const errors = [];
    for (const url of candidates) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(url, { cache: "no-store" });
        if (!res.ok) {
          errors.push(`${url}: HTTP ${res.status}`);
          continue;
        }
        const data = await res.json();
        if (!data || !Array.isArray(data.nodes) || !Array.isArray(data.edges)) {
          errors.push(`${url}: invalid JSON schema`);
          continue;
        }
        return data;
      } catch (err) {
        errors.push(`${url}: ${err.message}`);
      }
    }

    throw new Error(`Unable to load sitemap-data.json. Tried: ${errors.join(" | ")}`);
  }

  try {
    const data = await loadSitemapData();

    function normalizeLabel(label) {
      return String(label)
        .replace(/\s+[\u2013-]\s+Critical Alloy Research &amp; Discovery Lab$/i, "")
        .replace(/\s+[\u2013-]\s+Critical Alloy Research & Discovery Lab$/i, "")
        .trim();
    }

    function groupNameForPath(path) {
      const clean = String(path || "").replace(/^\/+/, "");
      const segments = clean.split("/");
      if (!clean || clean === "index.html" || segments.length === 1) {
        return "Main Pages";
      }

      const root = segments[0];
      const labels = {
        capabilities: "Capabilities",
        people: "People",
        research: "Research",
        files: "Files"
      };
      return labels[root] || root.replace(/[-_]/g, " ").replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
    }

    const grouped = new Map();
    const nodes = [...data.nodes].sort((a, b) => a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
    for (const node of nodes) {
      const groupName = groupNameForPath(node.path);
      if (!grouped.has(groupName)) {
        grouped.set(groupName, []);
      }
      grouped.get(groupName).push(node);
    }

    const maxDegree = nodes.reduce((max, node) => Math.max(max, Number(node.degree || 0)), 0);
    const topPage = nodes.find((node) => Number(node.degree || 0) === maxDegree);

    meta.innerHTML = [
      `<div class="sitemap-stat"><span class="sitemap-stat-label">Pages</span><span class="sitemap-stat-value">${data.nodeCount}</span></div>`,
      `<div class="sitemap-stat"><span class="sitemap-stat-label">Internal Links</span><span class="sitemap-stat-value">${data.edgeCount}</span></div>`,
      `<div class="sitemap-stat"><span class="sitemap-stat-label">Sections</span><span class="sitemap-stat-value">${grouped.size}</span></div>`,
      `<div class="sitemap-stat"><span class="sitemap-stat-label">Most Connected</span><span class="sitemap-stat-value" style="font-size:1rem;line-height:1.35;">${topPage ? escapeHtml(normalizeLabel(topPage.label)) : "N/A"}</span></div>`
    ].join("");

    groupsContainer.innerHTML = Array.from(grouped.entries())
      .sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0]))
      .map(([groupName, groupNodes]) => {
        const items = groupNodes
          .map((node) => {
            const label = normalizeLabel(node.label);
            return (
              `<div class="sitemap-item">` +
              `<div>` +
              `<a class="sitemap-link" href="${escapeHtml(node.id)}">${escapeHtml(label)}</a>` +
              `<div class="sitemap-path">${escapeHtml(node.path)}</div>` +
              `</div>` +
              `<div class="sitemap-badges">` +
              `<span class="sitemap-badge">In ${node.indegree}</span>` +
              `<span class="sitemap-badge">Out ${node.outdegree}</span>` +
              `</div>` +
              `</div>`
            );
          })
          .join("");

        return (
          `<details class="sitemap-group" open>` +
          `<summary>` +
          `<span class="sitemap-group-title">${escapeHtml(groupName)}</span>` +
          `<span class="sitemap-group-count">${groupNodes.length} page${groupNodes.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}</span>` +
          `</summary>` +
          `<div class="sitemap-list">${items}</div>` +
          `</details>`
        );
      })
      .join("");
  } catch (err) {
    meta.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#b91c1c;">Sitemap could not be loaded.</span>`;
    groupsContainer.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:1rem;color:#374151;border:1px solid #d9d9d9;border-radius:10px;">${escapeHtml(err.message)}</div>`;
  }
})();
</script>
```
